# PayoutDelta
> Open cross-border banking dataset and fee-benchmark engine.

## Overview
PayoutDelta models hidden correspondent banking deducts (SWIFT OUR/SHA/BEN), retail FX markups, and statutory export withholding taxes.

## Primary Corridors
- USD/PKR: Intermediary chains (CHASUS33, CITIUS33), FBR Section 154A (0.25% to 1%).
- USD/INR: Section 195 inward remittance rules.
- EUR/PHP: Multi-hop correspondent deducts.
- GBP/KES: Local clearing settlement spreads.

## Core Invariants
- R1: Strict bounding [, ,000,000].
- R2: Non-negative landing with \isFeeAbsorbed\ flag.
- R3: High-precision calculation; render via Intl.NumberFormat.
- R4: Fully typed static export architecture.
